exposure: Placental index (PI) measured by ultrasound elastography
Hardness of placental tissue score (HT score) measured by ultrasound elastography
outcome: Pathological ischemia findings of the placenta
cohort: The study included 111 pregnant women in their third trimester of pregnancy.
finding: Placental hardness, as determined by elastography, significantly correlates with lower estimated fetal body weight and birth weight, and higher HT scores were associated with pathological ischemia findings in the placenta.
